subject: International DPA: evidence handoff & routing clarifications
messages:
From: Elaine Torres <elaine.torres@novacare.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@novacare.com, marco.bianchi@novacare.it
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: DPA evidence: routing / UK addendum questions

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Thanks for sending the draft DPA back. Our legal & privacy teams ran the checklist and have three items we need clarified before we can sign:

1) UK addendum: The UK team wants explicit confirmation of which subprocessors will process UK-resident data and whether Redwood will accept the UK IDTA or the SCC+UK Addendum combination. We attached a short evidence checklist.
2) TIAs/DTIAs: We see references to "technical and organizational safeguards" and would like to map those to a scoped TIA for our healthcare workloads (PII + health). Can Redwood provide a TIA summary page (controls + retention + logging endpoints)?
3) Cross-border egress: For EU-origin data routed to US compute, can you confirm whether onshore cache fallback is enabled and where audit logs will be retained (region + retention window)?

Can you provide an evidence pack (subprocessor map, encryption in transit diagram, TIA summary) by EOD Monday (server time)? Marco (cc) will coordinate with our compliance ops.

Attachments: Novacare_DPA_EvidenceChecklist_v2.pdf

Thanks,
Elaine Torres
Head of Privacy Operations
Novacare Health

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: DPA evidence: routing / UK addendum questions

Marissa / Kim / Jordan — quick sync thread to split action items.

Elaine asked for an evidence pack by EOD Monday. Proposed split:
- Kim: confirm UK Addendum stance & provide formal statement on "UK IDTA vs SCC+Addendum" and list of UK-impacting subprocessors (output: short memo + subprocessor CSV).
- Marissa: lead customer comms and get Docusign cadence ready; coordinate contract redlines with legal.
- Jordan: produce TIA summary (controls matrix: encryption, key custody, logging endpoints, retention windows) and the onshore-fallback audit retention statement.

Kim — can you confirm whether the onshore cache fallback is a per-customer opt-in or default for Novacare-class customers? If opt-in, include steps + expected lead times.

I attached our current subprocessor map for reference (redwood-subprocessor-map.csv). I'll draft the note to Novacare once we have the pieces.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Partner Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-subprocessor-map.csv

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 20 Sep 2026 07:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA evidence: routing / UK addendum questions

Folks — factuals below for the pack. I'm copying Legal for any binding phrasing suggestions.

1) UK Addendum / IDTA stance: Redwood accepts the UK IDTA for UK-resident data. We also support SCCs with the UK Addendum where customers require both. Short formal line for Novacare: "Redwood will execute the UK IDTA for UK-resident personal data; where requested, Redwood will likewise execute SCCs supplemented by the UK Addendum." Legal to advise if we should prefer one.

2) Subprocessor exposure (UK-impacting): See attached CSV export (redwood-subprocessor-map.csv) — rows flagged as "UK-impacting" reflect processors with potential access to transit or cache nodes in eu-west-1 and eu-west-2. Primary processors: FastCache Inc (cache tier), LogStream Ltd (logs retention), S3-eu (object storage, encrypted at rest).

3) Onshore cache fallback: For regulated customers we currently offer onshore cache fallback as an opt-in during procurement; default is global routing with EU primary for EU customers. Opt-in steps: procurement flag + dedicated routing policy (2 week lead). Audit logs: retained in EU region by default for EU-scoped customers; retention window configurable up to 36 months (default 13 months).

Deliverables I will attach: 1) short memo (text block for the DPA), 2) redwood-subprocessor-map.csv. Jordan — ping me if you need more specifics for TIA matrix.

Kimberly Park
Senior Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-subprocessor-map.csv

Subject: Re: DPA evidence: routing / UK addendum questions

Thanks — this is very helpful. A couple quick clarifications from Novacare legal before we close out:

- Please include the specific audit log endpoints / bucket names used for EU-retained logs (or a template showing the naming pattern) so our Ops can verify ingestion.
- For the UK IDTA wording: can you provide the single-sentence legal snippet (as Kim drafted) in a copy-paste ready format for our countersignature page?
- DocuSign: we prefer to circulate after the evidence pack is attached to the contract. Can you drop the DocuSign link and expected signer list when ready?

If you can get the two small items and the evidence pack in the next 36 hours we can route to our CISO for final sign-off.

Best,
Marco Bianchi
Privacy Compliance Lead (EMEA)
Novacare Health
